_note: Schematic tissues. No measured values; shapes follow textbook figures. category groups the picker; subgroup splits nervous tissue into neuroglia and neurons; part.group headings split connective tissue into ground substance, fibres and cells; aliases map a links.json tis: key to a part of the tissue.

summary.en: Sheets of tightly packed cells that line surfaces and cavities. Drawn here as simple columnar epithelium over connective tissue.
summary.zh-Hant: 緊密排列嘅細胞層，覆蓋體表同襯貼腔道。圖中為單層柱狀上皮，下面係結締組織。

text.en: Short, finger-like projections of the apical membrane, each with an actin core. They enlarge the absorbing surface and form the brush border of intestinal and kidney epithelium.
text.zh-Hant: 頂端細胞膜向外伸出的短指狀突起，內含肌動蛋白核心。它們增加吸收面積，並在腸道與腎臟上皮形成刷狀緣。

text.en: Long, stiff, non-motile projections on the apical surface, built on actin filaments like very long microvilli. They are not true cilia. In inner-ear hair cells, bundles of stereocilia help convert sound vibrations into electrical signals.
text.zh-Hant: 頂端表面又長又硬的不能運動突起，以肌動蛋白絲構成，結構如超長的微絨毛，並非真正的纖毛。在內耳毛細胞中，靜纖毛束協助把聲音振動轉成電訊號。

text.en: Motile projections of the apical surface with a 9+2 microtubule core (axoneme). They beat together to move mucus or fluid across the surface, as in the airways and the uterine tube. Primary cilia have a 9+0 core and sense signals.
text.zh-Hant: 頂端表面可運動的突起，核心為 9+2 微管結構（軸絲）。它們協調擺動，推動黏液或液體越過表面，例如呼吸道與輸卵管。初級纖毛為 9+0 結構，負責感應訊號。

text.en: Hollow tubes of α- and β-tubulin. In cilia, nine outer doublets and two central singlets form the 9+2 axoneme, and dynein arms between doublets drive the bend. In the cell body, microtubules run from apex to base and carry vesicles.
text.zh-Hant: 由 α 與 β 微管蛋白組成的中空管。纖毛內九組外周雙微管與兩條中央單微管構成 9+2 軸絲，雙微管之間的動力蛋白臂驅動彎曲。在細胞體內，微管由頂端伸向基底，運送囊泡。

text.en: Columnar cells packed with very little space between them. Each cell has an apical side facing the lumen and a basal side on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 柱狀細胞，排列緊密，細胞之間幾乎冇空隙。每個細胞有朝向腔道嘅頂端同貼住基底膜嘅基底端。

text.en: Sits in the basal half of a columnar cell.
text.zh-Hant: 柱狀細胞嘅細胞核位於基底半部。

text.en: A belt of claudin and occludin strands just below the apical surface. It seals the gap between neighbouring cells, blocks leakage between them, and separates the apical from the basolateral membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於頂端表面下方的 claudin 與 occludin 蛋白條帶環繞細胞，封閉相鄰細胞之間的空隙，阻止物質從細胞間滲漏，並分隔頂端與基底外側細胞膜。

text.en: An adhesion belt under the tight junction. Cadherins bind neighbouring cells, and their tails link to actin filaments inside each cell. It gives mechanical strength and lets the sheet change shape.
text.zh-Hant: 位於緊密連接下方的黏著帶。鈣黏蛋白連接相鄰細胞，其胞內尾部與肌動蛋白絲相連，提供機械強度，並讓上皮層改變形狀。

text.en: A spot weld between cells. Desmosomal cadherins join the membranes, and plaques inside the cell anchor intermediate (keratin) filaments. Desmosomes resist shearing and are most common in tissues under strain, such as skin.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞之間的點狀焊接。橋粒鈣黏蛋白連接細胞膜，胞內斑塊錨定中間絲（角蛋白）。橋粒抵抗剪切力，在皮膚等受力組織中最為常見。

text.en: A cluster of channels made of connexin hexamers (connexons). The channels link the cytoplasm of two cells and let ions and small regulatory molecules pass, which coordinates activity between cells.
text.zh-Hant: 由連接蛋白六聚體（連接子）組成的通道群。通道連通兩個細胞的細胞質，讓離子及小型調節分子通過，協調細胞之間的活動。

text.en: The pale layer of the basal lamina next to the epithelial cells. Laminin and integrin-linked filaments cross it. It looks clear in electron micrographs.
text.zh-Hant: 基底層中緊貼上皮細胞的淺色層，有層黏連蛋白與連接整合素的細絲橫越。在電子顯微鏡下顯得透明。

text.en: The dark layer of the basal lamina below the lamina lucida. It is a sheet of type IV collagen, laminin and heparan sulfate proteoglycan such as perlecan. Reticular fibres of the connective tissue below anchor to it.
text.zh-Hant: 基底層中位於透明層下方的深色層，由 IV 型膠原蛋白、層黏連蛋白與硫酸肝素蛋白聚醣（如基底膜聚醣）組成的薄片。下方結締組織的網狀纖維錨定於此。

text.en: An anchor on the basal surface that fixes the cell to the basal lamina. Integrin α6β4 binds laminin in the lamina, and a plaque inside the cell anchors keratin filaments. It looks like half a desmosome.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底表面的錨點，把細胞固定於基底層。整合素 α6β4 與基底層的層黏連蛋白結合，胞內斑塊錨定角蛋白絲，外形似半個橋粒。

text.en: Supports the epithelium. Epithelium has no blood vessels of its own, so nutrients reach it from here.
text.zh-Hant: 支持上皮。上皮本身冇血管，養分由呢層供應。

text.en: Supplies the epithelium by diffusion across the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 養分擴散穿過基底膜，供應上皮。

text.en: Sensory endings run up into the epithelium.
text.zh-Hant: 感覺神經末梢伸入上皮。

summary.en: One layer of thin, flat cells. The short distance across it suits gas exchange and filtration, as in the air sacs of the lung and the lining of blood vessels.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層薄而扁平嘅細胞。跨越嘅距離短，適合氣體交換同過濾，例如肺泡同血管內襯。

text.en: Flat, thin cells that fit edge to edge like paving stones.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平而薄嘅細胞，邊對邊拼合，似鋪路石。

text.en: Flattened to match the cell and bulges slightly.
text.zh-Hant: 壓成扁平形，稍為凸起。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: One layer of cube-shaped cells with round, central nuclei. Found in kidney tubules and small gland ducts, where cells secrete or absorb.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層立方形細胞，細胞核圓而居中。見於腎小管同細小腺管，負責分泌或吸收。

text.en: Cells about as tall as they are wide.
text.zh-Hant: 高度同闊度相近嘅細胞。

text.en: Round and near the middle of the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 圓形，位於細胞中間附近。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: One layer of tall cells with nuclei near the base. Lines the stomach and intestine, where microvilli enlarge the absorbing surface and goblet cells make mucus.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層高身細胞，細胞核靠近底部。襯住胃同腸，微絨毛擴大吸收面積，杯狀細胞製造黏液。

text.en: Cells taller than they are wide.
text.zh-Hant: 高度大於闊度嘅細胞。

text.en: Oval and near the base of the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 橢圓形，靠近細胞基部。

text.en: Fine projections on the free surface that enlarge the area for absorption.
text.zh-Hant: 游離面嘅細小突起，增加吸收面積。

text.en: Single mucus-secreting cell with a swollen top.
text.zh-Hant: 分泌黏液嘅單個細胞，頂部膨大。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Many layers: dividing cuboidal cells at the base, flattened cells at the surface. Protects against wear in skin, mouth and oesophagus.
summary.zh-Hant: 多層結構：底部係分裂中嘅立方細胞，表面係扁平細胞。保護皮膚、口腔同食道免受磨損。

text.en: Flat cells that are shed and replaced from below. In skin they are filled with keratin.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平細胞，會脫落並由下方補充。喺皮膚入面充滿角蛋白。

text.en: Polygonal cells that flatten as they move upward.
text.zh-Hant: 多邊形細胞，向上移動時變得扁平。

text.en: Cuboidal cells that divide to renew the layers above.
text.zh-Hant: 立方細胞，不斷分裂以更新上面嘅層。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Two or more layers of cuboidal cells. Rare; lines the larger ducts of sweat and salivary glands.
summary.zh-Hant: 兩層或以上立方細胞。較罕見，襯住汗腺同唾液腺嘅較大導管。

text.en: Cuboidal cells facing the duct space.
text.zh-Hant: 面向管腔嘅立方細胞。

text.en: Cuboidal cells resting on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底膜上嘅立方細胞。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Cuboidal cells at the base and a surface layer of columnar cells. Rare; found in parts of the conjunctiva and large gland ducts.
summary.zh-Hant: 底部係立方細胞，表層係柱狀細胞。較罕見，見於部分結膜同大型腺管。

text.en: Tall columnar cells facing the free surface.
text.zh-Hant: 面向游離面嘅高身柱狀細胞。

text.en: Short cuboidal cells on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底膜上嘅矮身立方細胞。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: One layer that looks like several, because nuclei sit at different heights. Every cell touches the basement membrane. Ciliated in the trachea, with goblet cells.
summary.zh-Hant: 一層細胞，因細胞核高低不同而似多層。每個細胞都接觸基底膜。氣管內帶纖毛並有杯狀細胞。

text.en: Tall cells that reach the surface and carry cilia.
text.zh-Hant: 高身細胞，伸達表面並帶纖毛。

text.en: Beat together to sweep mucus and trapped particles along the surface.
text.zh-Hant: 協調擺動，將黏液同夾住嘅微粒沿表面推送。

text.en: Secretes mucus that traps particles.
text.zh-Hant: 分泌黏液以黏住微粒。

text.en: Do not reach the surface; they replace worn cells.
text.zh-Hant: 唔伸達表面，負責補充老化細胞。

text.en: Sit at different heights, which gives the layered look.
text.zh-Hant: 高低唔同，造成分層嘅外觀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Layers whose cell shapes change as the organ stretches. Lines the bladder and ureters; large dome-shaped umbrella cells sit at the surface.
summary.zh-Hant: 細胞形狀會隨器官伸展而改變嘅多層上皮。襯住膀胱同輸尿管，表面有大型圓頂狀傘細胞。

text.en: Large dome-shaped surface cells that flatten when the bladder fills.
text.zh-Hant: 表面嘅大型圓頂細胞，膀胱脹滿時會變扁。

text.en: Pear-shaped cells between the surface and the base.
text.zh-Hant: 位於表面同基部之間嘅梨形細胞。

text.en: Small cuboidal cells on the basement membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 位於基底膜上嘅細小立方細胞。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

text.en: Thin sheet under the cells that anchors the epithelium to the tissue below.
text.zh-Hant: 喺細胞下方嘅薄層，將上皮固定喺下面嘅組織。

summary.en: Cells scattered in an extracellular matrix of fibres and ground substance. Drawn here as loose connective tissue.
summary.zh-Hant: 細胞散佈於由纖維同基質組成嘅細胞外基質之中。圖中為疏鬆結締組織。

text.en: Gel-like material that fills the space between cells and fibres. Proteoglycans with glycosaminoglycan chains give it hydration and swelling pressure, which lets the tissue resist compression, and they help regulate collagen fibril formation.
text.zh-Hant: 填滿細胞與纖維之間空間的膠狀物質。帶糖胺聚醣鏈的蛋白聚醣提供水合與膨壓，使組織抵抗壓縮，並協助調節膠原纖維形成。

text.en: Strong, rope-like fibres grouped into bundles. They resist pulling. Collagen is the most abundant protein in animals: about one third of human protein and three quarters of the dry weight of skin. Each molecule is a triple helix of three α-chains with Gly at every third position. Type I (bone, skin, tendon, ligaments, cornea) is 80 to 90% of dermal collagen, type II is in cartilage and the vitreous humour, and type III is in skin and blood vessels.
text.zh-Hant: 堅韌如繩的纖維，聚成纖維束，抵抗拉力。膠原蛋白是動物中最豐富的蛋白質：約佔人體蛋白質的三分之一、皮膚乾重的四分之三。每個分子由三條 α 鏈組成三股螺旋，每隔兩個殘基即有一個 Gly。I 型（骨、皮膚、肌腱、韌帶、角膜）佔真皮膠原蛋白的 80% 至 90%；II 型見於軟骨與玻璃體；III 型見於皮膚與血管。

text.en: Thin branching fibres that stretch and recoil. Elastin, the insoluble polymer of tropoelastin, gives most of the elasticity of vertebrate tissue and forms elastic fibres in skin, lung and ligaments. Human tropoelastin (UniProt P15502) has 724 amino acids. Elastase digestion releases elastin-derived peptides that change how cells behave.
text.zh-Hant: 幼細分支的纖維，可伸展及回彈。彈性蛋白是原彈性蛋白的不溶性聚合物，賦予脊椎動物組織大部分彈性，並在皮膚、肺與韌帶中形成彈性纖維。人類原彈性蛋白（UniProt P15502）有 724 個胺基酸。彈性蛋白酶的分解會釋出彈性蛋白衍生肽，影響細胞行為。

text.en: Fine, branching fibres of type III collagen that form a supporting mesh around cells, vessels and basal laminae. In human lymph nodes they also contain the basement membrane proteins laminin and type IV collagen.
text.zh-Hant: 由 III 型膠原蛋白構成的幼細分支纖維，在細胞、血管與基底層周圍形成支持網。在人類淋巴結中，它們亦含基底膜蛋白層黏連蛋白與 IV 型膠原蛋白。

text.en: Flat, spindle-shaped cell that makes the fibres and ground substance.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平梭形細胞，製造纖維同基質。

text.en: Engulfs debris and microbes.
text.zh-Hant: 吞噬碎屑同微生物。

text.en: Makes antibodies.
text.zh-Hant: 製造抗體。

text.en: Round cell packed with granules, found mainly where tissue meets the external environment. It acts as a first responder: on stimulation it releases biologically active mediators in allergy and in innate and adaptive immunity.
text.zh-Hant: 充滿顆粒的圓形細胞，主要見於組織與外界相接之處。它是第一線反應細胞，受刺激時釋出生物活性介質，參與過敏及先天與適應性免疫。

text.en: Spindle-shaped, multipotent cell first found in bone marrow and later in many tissues. No single surface marker identifies it (Stro-1, SSEA-4, CD271 and CD146 are candidates), and it may have a fibroblast or pericyte origin.
text.zh-Hant: 梭形的多能細胞，最先在骨髓發現，後來亦見於多種組織。沒有單一表面標記可確認它（Stro-1、SSEA-4、CD271 與 CD146 為候選），其來源可能是纖維母細胞或周細胞。

text.en: Store lipid in one large droplet.
text.zh-Hant: 以一個大脂滴貯存脂質。

text.en: Brings nutrients and takes away waste.
text.zh-Hant: 運送養分及帶走廢物。

text.en: Carries signals to and from the tissue.
text.zh-Hant: 向組織傳入及傳出訊號。

summary.en: A fluid connective tissue: cells and cell fragments suspended in plasma. Drawn here as a small volume of plasma with red cells, the five white cell types and platelets.
summary.zh-Hant: 流動嘅結締組織，細胞同細胞碎片懸浮於血漿之中。圖中為一小段血漿，內有紅血球、五種白血球同血小板。

text.en: The liquid matrix of blood. It is mostly water and carries proteins, nutrients, hormones, gases and waste.
text.zh-Hant: 血液嘅液體基質，主要係水，運載蛋白質、養分、荷爾蒙、氣體同廢物。

text.en: Biconcave disc with no nucleus. Packed with haemoglobin, it carries oxygen and some carbon dioxide.
text.zh-Hant: 雙凹圓盤狀，冇細胞核，載滿血紅素，運載氧氣同部分二氧化碳。

text.en: Multilobed nucleus. It is recruited from the blood to infected or injured tissue and drives acute inflammation.
text.zh-Hant: 多葉細胞核。從血液被招募至感染或受傷組織，推動急性炎症。

text.en: Bilobed nucleus and large red-orange granules. It protects against parasites and takes part in asthma and other inflammation.
text.zh-Hant: 雙葉細胞核同大型紅橙色顆粒，抵禦寄生蟲，亦參與哮喘同其他炎症。

text.en: Large dark blue granules that often hide the nucleus. It is an innate effector cell in allergic responses and some defence against pathogens.
text.zh-Hant: 大型深藍色顆粒，常遮住細胞核。係先天免疫效應細胞，參與過敏反應同部分病原體防禦。

text.en: Round nucleus that fills most of the cell, with a thin rim of cytoplasm. Each B or T cell bears a unique antigen receptor. NK cells are innate lymphocytes that limit tumours and infections.
text.zh-Hant: 圓形細胞核佔細胞大部分，細胞質只有薄薄一圈。每個 B 或 T 細胞帶有獨特嘅抗原受體；NK 細胞係先天免疫淋巴細胞，限制腫瘤同感染。

text.en: White cell with a kidney-shaped nucleus. In inflammation, circulating monocytes enter tissue and can also replenish some resident macrophage pools.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞核呈腎形嘅白血球。炎症時，循環單核球進入組織，亦可補充部分常駐巨噬細胞。

text.en: Small anucleate fragment released by a megakaryocyte in bone marrow. Platelets help prevent bleeding and limit vessel injury.
text.zh-Hant: 骨髓巨核細胞釋出嘅無核小碎片，協助防止出血同減輕血管損傷。

summary.en: Unilocular fat cell. One large lipid droplet fills the cell and pushes the nucleus and a thin rim of cytoplasm to the edge. It stores energy as triacylglycerol and releases hormones such as leptin.
summary.zh-Hant: 單泡脂肪細胞，一個大脂滴佔滿細胞，將細胞核同薄薄嘅細胞質推到邊緣。以三酸甘油酯貯存能量，亦分泌瘦體素等荷爾蒙。

text.en: One large droplet of triacylglycerol. It takes up most of the cell volume and gives the cell a signet-ring look in section.
text.zh-Hant: 單一大脂滴，成分為三酸甘油酯，佔細胞大部分體積，切片上呈印戒狀。

text.en: Thin layer of cytoplasm around the droplet.
text.zh-Hant: 圍繞脂滴嘅薄層細胞質。

text.en: Flattened and pushed to the cell edge by the droplet.
text.zh-Hant: 被脂滴擠壓，扁平並偏向細胞邊緣。

text.en: Each adipocyte lies against a capillary, which supplies the cell and carries away released fatty acids.
text.zh-Hant: 每個脂肪細胞貼近微血管，微血管供應細胞，並運走釋出嘅脂肪酸。

summary.en: Multilocular fat cell packed with mitochondria. It burns fatty acids to make heat instead of ATP, using uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1).
summary.zh-Hant: 多泡脂肪細胞，載滿粒線體。利用解偶聯蛋白 1（UCP1）燃燒脂肪酸產熱，而唔係製造 ATP。

text.en: Many small droplets. Brown fat combusts large amounts of lipid and glucose to make heat.
text.zh-Hant: 多個細小脂滴。棕色脂肪燃燒大量脂質同葡萄糖產熱。

text.en: Carry uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1), the characteristic protein of brown fat, which turns energy from food into heat.
text.zh-Hant: 載有解偶聯蛋白 1（UCP1），係棕色脂肪嘅特徵蛋白，將食物能量轉為熱能。

text.en: Round and near the centre, since the droplets do not displace it.
text.zh-Hant: 呈圓形，位置近中央，因為脂滴冇將它推開。

text.en: Fills the space between droplets and mitochondria.
text.zh-Hant: 填滿脂滴同粒線體之間嘅空間。

text.en: Dense capillary supply brings oxygen and fuel, and carries heat away in the blood.
text.zh-Hant: 豐富嘅微血管網供應氧氣同燃料，並以血流帶走熱能。

text.en: Noradrenaline released from sympathetic nerves controls heat production and the recruitment of the tissue, for example in the cold.
text.zh-Hant: 交感神經釋出嘅去甲腎上腺素控制產熱同組織嘅增生，例如喺寒冷環境。

summary.en: Inducible thermogenic fat cell found inside white fat. Cold or β-adrenergic stimulation turns white adipocytes into cells with several droplets, more mitochondria and UCP1.
summary.zh-Hant: 白色脂肪組織內可被誘導嘅產熱脂肪細胞。寒冷或 β 腎上腺素刺激令白色脂肪細胞變成有多個脂滴、較多粒線體同 UCP1 嘅細胞。

text.en: Beige cells sit in white fat and look like white cells at rest. The droplet size here is a schematic choice between white and brown.
text.zh-Hant: 米色細胞位於白色脂肪內，靜止時外觀似白色細胞。圖中脂滴大小係示意，介乎白色同棕色之間。

text.en: UCP1 is very low at rest and rises with high respiration after cAMP stimulation, so heat output is inducible.
text.zh-Hant: UCP1 靜止時極低，cAMP 刺激後同呼吸率一齊上升，所以產熱可被誘導。

text.en: Round and near the centre, since the droplets do not displace it.
text.zh-Hant: 呈圓形，位置近中央，因為脂滴冇將它推開。

text.en: Fills the space between droplets and mitochondria.
text.zh-Hant: 填滿脂滴同粒線體之間嘅空間。

text.en: Dense capillary supply brings oxygen and fuel, and carries heat away in the blood.
text.zh-Hant: 豐富嘅微血管網供應氧氣同燃料，並以血流帶走熱能。

text.en: Drawn by analogy with brown fat. Various activators make beige cells develop in white fat (browning).
text.zh-Hant: 按棕色脂肪類推繪出。多種活化因子令白色脂肪中形成米色細胞（褐變）。

summary.en: Spindle-shaped cell of connective tissue. It makes collagen, elastin and ground substance, and drives wound repair. Drawn here with branching processes and secretory vesicles.
summary.zh-Hant: 結締組織嘅梭形細胞，製造膠原蛋白、彈性蛋白同基質，並推動傷口修復。圖中有分支突起同分泌小泡。

text.en: Flat spindle with abundant rough endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi apparatus, which carry procollagen through the secretory pathway.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平梭形，含豐富嘅粗面內質網同高爾基體，負責經分泌途徑運送前膠原。

text.en: Elongated and often indented, lying along the long axis of the cell.
text.zh-Hant: 細長，常有凹陷，沿細胞長軸排列。

text.en: Thin branching extensions that attach to the matrix and to neighbouring cells. Fibroblasts can pull on matrix fibres, and contractile myofibroblasts do so to close wounds.
text.zh-Hant: 幼細分支嘅突起，附著於基質同鄰近細胞。纖維母細胞能拉動基質纖維，收縮性肌纖維母細胞藉此閉合傷口。

text.en: Carry procollagen through the secretory pathway to the cell surface. Outside the cell, procollagen metalloproteinases convert it to collagen, which assembles into fibrils.
text.zh-Hant: 經分泌途徑將前膠原運到細胞表面。細胞外嘅前膠原金屬蛋白酶將它轉變為膠原，再組裝成纖維。

text.en: Fibrils laid down by the cell. They let connective tissue withstand tensile forces.
text.zh-Hant: 由細胞形成嘅纖維，令結締組織能承受拉力。

text.en: Gel-like extracellular matrix that fills the space between cells and fibres. Fibroblasts are its principal source.
text.zh-Hant: 填滿細胞同纖維之間空間嘅膠狀細胞外基質，纖維母細胞係它嘅主要來源。

summary.en: Mature bone cell, trapped in a lacuna inside mineralised matrix. Its processes run through canaliculi to neighbouring cells and the central canal. Drawn here in one osteon.
summary.zh-Hant: 成熟骨細胞，困喺礦化基質內嘅骨陷窩中，突起穿過骨小管連接鄰近細胞同中央管。圖中為一個骨單位。

text.en: Long-lived bone cell entombed in mineralised matrix. It senses mechanical load and regulates osteoblasts and osteoclasts, for example through sclerostin, a BMP antagonist.
text.zh-Hant: 埋於礦化基質內嘅長壽骨細胞，感測機械負荷並調控成骨細胞同破骨細胞，例如透過 BMP 拮抗劑硬化蛋白。

text.en: Cavity in the mineralised matrix that holds the cell. Fluid moves through the space around the cell in the lacunar-canalicular system.
text.zh-Hant: 礦化基質內容納細胞嘅空腔。組織液喺細胞周圍嘅空間，沿骨陷窩-骨小管系統流動。

text.en: Narrow channels that hold the cell processes and link lacunae into a network. Cells communicate through gap junctions and through fluid moving in the lacunar-canalicular system.
text.zh-Hant: 容納細胞突起嘅幼細通道，將骨陷窩連成網絡。細胞透過間隙連接同骨陷窩-骨小管系統內嘅液體流動溝通。

text.en: Concentric layers of mineralised matrix around the central canal. Collagen fibres run in a different direction in neighbouring layers.
text.zh-Hant: 圍繞中央管嘅同心圓礦化基質層，相鄰層嘅膠原纖維方向唔同。

text.en: Runs along the osteon and carries a blood vessel and nerve fibres.
text.zh-Hant: 沿骨單位走向，內有血管同神經纖維。

text.en: Collagen and non-collagenous proteins, mineralised with calcium. Mineralisation makes bone strong.
text.zh-Hant: 膠原同非膠原蛋白，經鈣礦化。礦化令骨骼堅固。

summary.en: Cells specialised to contract. The three types are skeletal, cardiac and smooth muscle.
summary.zh-Hant: 專門收縮嘅細胞。三種類型為骨骼肌、心肌同平滑肌。

text.en: Long, cylindrical, striated fibres with many nuclei pushed to the edge. Voluntary control.
text.zh-Hant: 長圓柱形有橫紋嘅肌纖維，多個細胞核靠近邊緣。受意識控制。

text.en: Striated, branched fibres with one central nucleus. Dark intercalated discs join the cells end to end. Involuntary.
text.zh-Hant: 有橫紋、有分支，一個中央細胞核。深色嘅閏盤將細胞首尾相連。不受意識控制。

text.en: Short spindle-shaped cells with one central nucleus and no striations. Found in walls of hollow organs and vessels. Involuntary.
text.zh-Hant: 短梭形細胞，一個中央細胞核，冇橫紋。見於空腔器官同血管壁。不受意識控制。

summary.en: Neurons carry electrical signals and supporting glial cells insulate and protect them. Drawn here as one neuron with a myelinated axon.
summary.zh-Hant: 神經元傳遞電訊號，支持嘅神經膠質細胞負責絕緣同保護。圖中為一個有髓鞘軸突嘅神經元。

text.en: Contains the nucleus and most organelles of the neuron.
text.zh-Hant: 包含神經元嘅細胞核同大部分細胞器。

text.en: Holds the neuron's DNA.
text.zh-Hant: 載有神經元嘅 DNA。

text.en: Branched extensions that receive signals from other neurons.
text.zh-Hant: 分支狀突起，接收其他神經元嘅訊號。

text.en: Long extension that carries signals away from the cell body.
text.zh-Hant: 長突起，將訊號由細胞體傳出。

text.en: Insulating layers wrapped around the axon in segments. They speed up signal conduction.
text.zh-Hant: 分段包裹軸突嘅絕緣層，加快訊號傳導。

text.en: Gap between myelin segments where the axon is exposed and the signal is regenerated.
text.zh-Hant: 髓鞘分段之間嘅縫隙，軸突外露，訊號喺此再生。

text.en: Glial cell of the central nervous system. Its processes wrap axons in myelin.
text.zh-Hant: 中樞神經系統嘅膠質細胞，其突起以髓鞘包裹軸突。

text.en: Axon ends in bulbs that pass the signal to the next cell.
text.zh-Hant: 軸突末端膨大成球，將訊號傳給下一個細胞。

text.en: Carries signals toward the central nervous system (CNS). Sensory nerves are afferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳向中樞神經系統（CNS）。感覺神經屬傳入。

text.en: Carries signals away from the CNS to muscles or glands. Motor nerves are efferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。運動神經屬傳出。

note.en: In this neuron the signal passes from the dendrites to the cell body, then along the axon to the terminals.
note.zh-Hant: 喺呢個神經元，訊號由樹突傳到細胞體，再沿軸突傳到末端。

summary.en: Star-shaped glial cell of the central nervous system. Its processes support neurons, regulate the chemical surroundings and reach blood vessels with end-feet.
summary.zh-Hant: 中樞神經系統嘅星形膠質細胞。突起支持神經元、調節化學環境，並以終足接觸血管。

text.en: Holds the nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 載有細胞核。

text.en: Branching arms that contact neurons and synapses.
text.zh-Hant: 分支嘅突起，接觸神經元同突觸。

text.en: Flattened ends on the blood vessel wall; they help form the blood–brain barrier.
text.zh-Hant: 貼喺血管壁上嘅扁平末端，協助形成血腦屏障。

text.en: Small blood vessel in the brain.
text.zh-Hant: 腦內嘅細小血管。

summary.en: Small immune cell of the central nervous system. Thin branched processes survey the tissue and the cell engulfs debris.
summary.zh-Hant: 中樞神經系統嘅細小免疫細胞。幼細分支突起巡視組織，並吞噬碎屑。

text.en: Small body with a dense nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 細小嘅胞體，細胞核較致密。

text.en: Thin branches that continually probe the surroundings.
text.zh-Hant: 不斷探測周圍嘅幼細分支。

text.en: A damaged fragment being engulfed by phagocytosis.
text.zh-Hant: 正被吞噬嘅受損碎片。

summary.en: Ciliated cells lining the brain ventricles and the spinal central canal. Their cilia help move cerebrospinal fluid.
summary.zh-Hant: 襯住腦室同脊髓中央管嘅纖毛細胞。纖毛協助推動腦脊髓液。

text.en: Cuboidal to columnar cells in a single sheet.
text.zh-Hant: 排成單層嘅立方至柱狀細胞。

text.en: Beat to circulate cerebrospinal fluid.
text.zh-Hant: 擺動以推動腦脊髓液流動。

text.en: Ventricle or canal filled with cerebrospinal fluid.
text.zh-Hant: 充滿腦脊髓液嘅腦室或管道。

text.en: Holds the DNA. Its shape and position follow the cell shape.
text.zh-Hant: 載有 DNA，形狀同位置跟隨細胞形狀。

summary.en: Central nervous system cell that makes myelin. One cell sends processes to wrap segments of several axons.
summary.zh-Hant: 製造髓鞘嘅中樞神經系統細胞。一個細胞會伸出突起，包裹數條軸突嘅節段。

text.en: Holds the nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 載有細胞核。

text.en: Each process flattens and wraps one axon segment.
text.zh-Hant: 每條突起會攤平並包裹一段軸突。

text.en: Insulating layers that speed up signal conduction.
text.zh-Hant: 絕緣層，加快訊號傳導。

text.en: Neuron fibres wrapped by the same oligodendrocyte.
text.zh-Hant: 由同一個寡突膠質細胞包裹嘅神經纖維。

summary.en: Flat glial cells of the peripheral nervous system that surround neuron cell bodies in ganglia and regulate their surroundings.
summary.zh-Hant: 周圍神經系統嘅扁平膠質細胞，圍住神經節內嘅神經元細胞體，並調節其周圍環境。

text.en: Neuron cell body with its nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 神經元細胞體及其細胞核。

text.en: Flat cells forming a capsule around the cell body.
text.zh-Hant: 扁平細胞，圍成包住細胞體嘅囊。

summary.en: Peripheral nervous system cell that wraps one segment of one axon in myelin. Gaps between neighbours are the nodes of Ranvier.
summary.zh-Hant: 周圍神經系統細胞，以髓鞘包裹一條軸突嘅一個節段。相鄰細胞之間嘅空隙係蘭氏結。

text.en: Nerve fibre carrying the signal.
text.zh-Hant: 傳送訊號嘅神經纖維。

text.en: Many wraps of Schwann cell membrane.
text.zh-Hant: 許旺細胞膜嘅多重包裹層。

text.en: Cytoplasm pushed to the outside of the sheath.
text.zh-Hant: 被推到髓鞘外層嘅細胞質。

text.en: Lies on the outer surface of the sheath.
text.zh-Hant: 位於髓鞘外表面。

text.en: Bare axon between two Schwann cells; the signal jumps from node to node.
text.zh-Hant: 兩個許旺細胞之間裸露嘅軸突，訊號喺結與結之間跳躍傳導。

summary.en: Carries signals from a receptor toward the central nervous system. One stem leaves the cell body and splits into a peripheral and a central process.
summary.zh-Hant: 將訊號由感受器傳向中樞神經系統。一條主幹離開細胞體後分成周邊突同中樞突。

text.en: Sits in a ganglion, off to the side of the signal path.
text.zh-Hant: 位於神經節，偏離訊號路徑。

text.en: Brings the signal from the receptor to the cell body region.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由感受器帶到細胞體附近。

text.en: Carries the signal into the spinal cord or brain.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號送入脊髓或腦。

text.en: Detects touch, stretch, temperature or pain.
text.zh-Hant: 偵測觸覺、拉伸、溫度或痛覺。

text.en: Pass the signal on to neurons in the central nervous system.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳給中樞神經系統內嘅神經元。

text.en: Carries signals toward the central nervous system (CNS). Sensory nerves are afferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳向中樞神經系統（CNS）。感覺神經屬傳入。

text.en: Carries signals away from the CNS to muscles or glands. Motor nerves are efferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。運動神經屬傳出。

note.en: In this neuron the signal passes from the dendrites to the cell body, then along the axon to the terminals.
note.zh-Hant: 喺呢個神經元，訊號由樹突傳到細胞體，再沿軸突傳到末端。

summary.en: Carries signals from the central nervous system to a muscle or gland. A multipolar cell with many dendrites and one long axon.
summary.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。多極細胞，有多條樹突同一條長軸突。

text.en: Receives input and holds the nucleus.
text.zh-Hant: 接收輸入並載有細胞核。

text.en: Branches that receive signals from other neurons.
text.zh-Hant: 接收其他神經元訊號嘅分支。

text.en: Long fibre carrying the signal away from the cell body.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由細胞體傳走嘅長纖維。

text.en: Release neurotransmitter onto the muscle fibre.
text.zh-Hant: 向肌纖維釋放神經傳遞物質。

text.en: Target cell that contracts.
text.zh-Hant: 會收縮嘅目標細胞。

text.en: Carries signals toward the central nervous system (CNS). Sensory nerves are afferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳向中樞神經系統（CNS）。感覺神經屬傳入。

text.en: Carries signals away from the CNS to muscles or glands. Motor nerves are efferent.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號由中樞神經系統傳向肌肉或腺體。運動神經屬傳出。

note.en: In this neuron the signal passes from the dendrites to the cell body, then along the axon to the terminals.
note.zh-Hant: 喺呢個神經元，訊號由樹突傳到細胞體，再沿軸突傳到末端。

name.zh-Hant: 中間神經元（傳遞神經元）

summary.en: Connects neurons to neurons inside the central nervous system, linking sensory input to motor output. Multipolar, with a short axon.
summary.zh-Hant: 喺中樞神經系統內連接神經元，將感覺輸入連到運動輸出。多極，軸突較短。

text.en: Holds the nucleus and integrates incoming signals.
text.zh-Hant: 載有細胞核並整合傳入訊號。

text.en: Receive signals from sensory and other neurons.
text.zh-Hant: 接收感覺神經元同其他神經元嘅訊號。

text.en: Branches locally instead of leaving the central nervous system.
text.zh-Hant: 喺局部分支，唔離開中樞神經系統。

text.en: Pass the signal to the next neuron.
text.zh-Hant: 將訊號傳給下一個神經元。

summary.en: A generalised animal cell with the organelles of a textbook figure: nucleus, endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus, mitochondria, lysosomes, vacuole, centrioles and cytoskeleton. Schematic: no measured volume fractions.
summary.zh-Hant: 依教科書圖示繪成的一般動物細胞，含細胞核、內質網、高爾基體、粒線體、溶酶體、液泡、中心粒與細胞骨架。示意圖：沒有量度的體積比例。

text.en: Lipid bilayer that bounds the cell and controls what enters and leaves. Drawn as one translucent shell.
text.zh-Hant: 包圍細胞的脂質雙層，控制物質進出。圖中以一層半透明外殼表示。

text.en: Everything inside the plasma membrane except the nucleus: the cytosol with its organelles and cytoskeleton.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞膜內、細胞核以外的全部內容：細胞質基質連同其中的細胞器與細胞骨架。

text.en: Double membrane around the nucleus, studded with pores and continuous with the rough ER.
text.zh-Hant: 包圍細胞核的雙層膜，佈滿核孔，並與粗面內質網相連。

text.en: DNA wound on histones, filling the nuclear interior.
text.zh-Hant: 纏繞在組織蛋白上的 DNA，充滿細胞核內部。

text.en: Dense region of the nucleus where ribosomal RNA is made and ribosomes begin to assemble.
text.zh-Hant: 細胞核內的緻密區域，在此製造核糖體 RNA，並開始組裝核糖體。

text.en: Stacked flattened sacs coated with ribosomes. Makes secreted and membrane proteins.
text.zh-Hant: 表面附有核糖體的層疊扁平囊，製造分泌蛋白與膜蛋白。

text.en: Branching tubules with no ribosomes. Makes lipids and handles detoxification and calcium storage in many cells.
text.zh-Hant: 不附核糖體的分支小管，製造脂質；在許多細胞中也負責解毒與儲存鈣。

text.en: Stack of cisternae that modifies and sorts proteins from the ER into vesicles.
text.zh-Hant: 由扁囊層疊而成，修飾來自內質網的蛋白質，並分選到囊泡中。

text.en: Double-membrane organelle that makes most of the cell's ATP by oxidative phosphorylation.
text.zh-Hant: 雙層膜細胞器，經氧化磷酸化製造細胞大部分 ATP。

text.en: Membrane-bound sac of digestive enzymes that breaks down worn-out organelles and material taken up from outside.
text.zh-Hant: 內含消化酵素的膜囊，分解老化的細胞器與自外界攝入的物質。

text.en: Membrane-bound sac that stores fluid and other material. In animal cells it is small and short-lived.
text.zh-Hant: 儲存液體與其他物質的膜囊；在動物細胞中體積小、存在時間短。

text.en: Pair of short barrels at right angles, each a ring of microtubule blades. They organise the microtubules of an animal cell.
text.zh-Hant: 成對的短筒、彼此成直角，每個由一圈微管組成；負責組織動物細胞的微管。

text.en: Make proteins. Bound to the rough ER or free in the cytosol. The 80S ribosome (PDB 4UG0) can be opened in Module B.
text.zh-Hant: 製造蛋白質；附在粗面內質網上，或游離在細胞質基質中。80S 核糖體（PDB 4UG0）可在 Module B 打開。

text.en: Clusters of branched glucose polymer stored in the cytosol as an energy reserve.
text.zh-Hant: 儲存在細胞質基質中的分支葡萄糖聚合物顆粒，作為能量儲備。

text.en: Thinnest cytoskeletal fibres, made of actin. They shape the cell surface and drive crawling and contraction.
text.zh-Hant: 最細的細胞骨架纖維，由肌動蛋白組成；塑造細胞表面，並驅動爬行與收縮。

text.en: Rope-like fibres that give the cell mechanical strength.
text.zh-Hant: 繩索狀纖維，賦予細胞機械強度。

text.en: Hollow tubes of tubulin that form tracks for transport and the spindle for cell division.
text.zh-Hant: 由微管蛋白組成的中空管，構成運輸軌道與細胞分裂的紡錘體。

summary.en: A rod-shaped bacterium with no nucleus and no membrane-bound organelles. Schematic: no measured volume fractions yet.
summary.zh-Hant: 桿狀細菌，冇細胞核，亦冇膜包圍嘅細胞器。示意圖：暫時未有量度嘅體積比例。

text.en: Outer membrane, thin cell wall and inner membrane enclose the cell. Drawn as one translucent shell.
text.zh-Hant: 外膜、薄細胞壁同內膜包圍住細胞。圖中以一層半透明外殼表示。

text.en: Gel-like interior with no membrane-bound organelles. Metabolism and protein synthesis happen here.
text.zh-Hant: 膠狀內部，冇膜包圍嘅細胞器。代謝同蛋白質合成喺度進行。

text.en: The circular chromosome, folded into a tangle in a region with no nuclear envelope.
text.zh-Hant: 環狀染色體，摺疊成一團，所在區域冇核膜。

text.en: Small circular DNA rings separate from the chromosome. They often carry genes such as antibiotic resistance.
text.zh-Hant: 同染色體分開嘅小型環狀 DNA，常帶有例如抗生素抗藥性嘅基因。

text.en: Make proteins. Smaller than eukaryotic ribosomes, so some antibiotics block them without harming the host's own.
text.zh-Hant: 製造蛋白質。比真核生物嘅核糖體細，所以部分抗生素可阻斷佢哋而唔傷害宿主自己嘅核糖體。

text.en: Short surface hairs that attach the cell to surfaces and to other cells.
text.zh-Hant: 表面短毛，令細胞附著於表面或其他細胞。

text.en: Long helical filaments turned by a motor in the envelope. They push the cell through liquid.
text.zh-Hant: 長螺旋絲，由包膜上嘅馬達帶動旋轉，推動細胞喺液體中游動。

summary.en: A virus that infects bacteria. It is not a cell: it has no cytoplasm and cannot grow or divide on its own. Schematic with no data table.
summary.zh-Hant: 感染細菌嘅病毒。佢唔係細胞：冇細胞質，亦唔能獨立生長或分裂。示意圖，冇數據表。

text.en: Icosahedral protein shell that protects the genome.
text.zh-Hant: 二十面體蛋白質外殼，保護基因組。

text.en: Double-stranded DNA packed tightly inside the head. It is injected into the host bacterium during infection.
text.zh-Hant: 緊密包裝於頭部內嘅雙鏈 DNA，感染時注入宿主細菌。

text.en: Joins the head to the tail.
text.zh-Hant: 連接頭部同尾部。

text.en: Protein sleeve around the tail tube. It contracts to drive the tube through the host's envelope.
text.zh-Hant: 包住尾管嘅蛋白質套筒，收縮時將尾管推穿宿主嘅包膜。

text.en: Hollow core through which the DNA passes into the host.
text.zh-Hant: 中空嘅核心管道，DNA 經此進入宿主。

text.en: Hexagonal plate at the tail tip. It binds the host surface and triggers sheath contraction.
text.zh-Hant: 尾端嘅六角形板，結合宿主表面並觸發鞘收縮。

text.en: Short pins under the baseplate that anchor the phage to the host.
text.zh-Hant: 基板下方嘅短刺，將噬菌體固定於宿主。

text.en: Jointed fibres that recognise receptors on the host surface and hold the phage in place.
text.zh-Hant: 有關節嘅纖維，識別宿主表面嘅受體並將噬菌體固定。
